key_concepts: Null MAT has no effect on material data; it is an instance of the MAT connected to its input.
Use Null MAT as a stable named endpoint for Geometry COMP material parameters, Select MAT paths, and component-internal material references.
Although it is intended as a pass-through, deform and common MAT render-state pages can still affect rendering if explicitly changed.
Null MAT is useful at component boundaries where upstream material internals may change but the public material reference should remain stable.
Info CHOP diagnostics are available for monitoring common operator state such as cook timing, warnings, and errors.
common_gotchas: Use Null MAT as the stable reference target for Geometry COMP material parameters.
Although intended as a no-op, common render-state pages can still affect behavior if they are explicitly changed.
Null MAT does not create a material without an input; make sure the upstream material path is valid.
It is useful at component boundaries where upstream material internals may change.
